summary: The note surveys small artisanal dairy farms around the world and the cheese and yogurt varieties they produce, from Somerset cheddar to Indian dahi. It covers sustainability, community education, revival of ancient recipes, probiotic health benefits, cheese tourism and cross-cultural experimentation. It argues that local dairies are custodians of culture and community with a promising future.
one_line: A survey of small artisanal dairy farms worldwide and their cheeses and yogurts, covering sustainability, education, innovation, health and cheese tourism.
key_facts: Eleanor Rigby, a cheese artisan from Somerset, UK, is known for her cheddar, a cheese with origins stretching back to the 12th century.
As of September 2023, Eleanor Rigby and her team at Meadow View Farms have been innovating with cave-aged cheddar variants with an earthy profile.
Jon Peterson leads Peterson's Dairy in Wisconsin, USA, which produces award-winning cheeses including a peppery Monterey Jack.
On October 10, 2023, the Livanos Family Dairy, a small-batch Greek yogurt producer, was spotlighted at the Global Yogurt Summit in Athens, Greece.
Priya Singh's artisanal dairy in New Delhi, India, produces dahi and introduced spiced dahis with cardamom, saffron, and cumin.
Priya Singh's Golden Delhi Dahi won the regional flavor award in November 2023.
Mark Walters, an agronomist, said at the 'Future of Dairy' conference on December 5th, 2023 that small dairy farms often have a lesser environmental footprint.
At Alpine Meadow Creamery in Switzerland, cows graze on natural, pesticide-free pastures, yielding superior milk for Alpine cheeses.
Willow Bend Farms in Vermont, USA, led by Sarah Thompson, holds regular cheese-making workshops for locals.
Emerald Isle Creamery in Ireland, founded September 1st, 2023, has resurrected ancient Irish cheese recipes that were on the brink of extinction.
Dr. Angela Pearson said at the 'Dairy for Health' symposium in California on September 15th, 2023 that small-batch yogurts often contain a wider variety of probiotic cultures.
Eliza Martinez's Blue Sky Dairy in California has begun experimenting with sheep's milk to produce Manchego, traditionally a Spanish cheese.
Cheese tourism includes the 'Cheese Trails' in the French countryside and the 'Queso Quest' in Mexico, where visitors sample traditional queso fresco.
